svg.text: Phase 2 · step 3e · Messages: the message center (decisions #040, #050): two options
Messages come from what's true now; each person marks them read or dismisses them. Admin messages show only in Admin mode. Both options share the badge and the urgent banner (top).
Both options · the unread badge (sidebar and phone tabs) and the urgent banner on every screen
Any screen · an urgent message is showing
The banner shows the newest urgent message;
View opens it in Messages. Dismiss there hides it.
Badge = unread messages you can see now
(Admin messages count only in Admin mode).
Severity colors: urgent red, warning amber, info blue.
Urgent messages never rely on color alone:
A · One list of cards; each card shows everything and has its buttons (Mark read, Dismiss, one action)
